text:
Mira Chen: Heads-up, I did a pass on the Q3 RICE sheet, we need to lock before leadership review tomorrow.
Alex W: On it. Which rows are you most worried about?
Mira Chen: Two things: the KV cache entry and the Dedicated autoscale. KV cache reach/effort feel contested.
Jonathan R: Agree on effort. The multi-model cache has a big test matrix + perf flakiness. I think effort should be `8` not `4`.
Sara N: From CS: requests came from 3 mid-market customers + one enterprise POC. They call it blocking due to P95 SLA risk.
Priya S: If it's blocking an enterprise conversion, impact could be larger than pure reach suggests. Maybe add a strategic conversion multiplier to Impact.
Ben K: Proposal: split into "KV cache: hosted MVP" and "KV cache: multi-model follow-up". MVP is lower effort and captures most customer pain.
Alex W: If MVP is scoped hosted-only, Reach ~30k, Impact 6, Confidence 3, Effort 3 => quick calc R*I/C/E -> use sheet formula, should move it up.
Mira Chen: I'll update the sheet with the scoped MVP numbers and note the follow-up as Q4 candidate.
pm-bot: q3-roadmap sheet updated by Mira Chen (row 22) - "KV cache (MVP)" scope changed to hosted-only
Jonathan R: Also add acceptance criteria: perf harness, regression test matrix, and rollout plan with feature flags. Keeps scope tight.
Priya S: And document the customer conversion case in the ticket so PMs can re-evaluate impact after POC.
Sara N: +1 from CS. We'll prepare a one-pager for the enterprise trial explaining risk mitigation.
Ben K: I'll split the JIRA epic and create two sub-epics with clear DoR and DoD for MVP.
Mira Chen: On autoscale: usage telemetry shows lower immediate demand. Recommend moving it down one slot unless more escalations appear.
Alex W: Sounds reasonable. We can keep a monitoring alert to re-prioritize if traffic spikes.
Mira Chen: Decision summary: Promote KV cache MVP (hosted-only) with updated R/I/C/E; split multi-model to Q4; deprioritize autoscale for now. Action: I'll ping for final thumbs by EOD.
Alex W: \ud83d\udc4d
Ben K: Will add acceptance criteria and link the customer POC notes.
pm-bot: Reminder: roadmap lock scheduled tomorrow 16:00 PT.
